search.query: index=bro sourcetype=bro_kerberos client!="" success=true | rex field=client "(?[^\/]([^/]+)$)" | eval Domain_Name=upper(Domain_Name) | eval Day=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d") | eval Hour=strftime(_time, "%H") | eval Hour_With_Minutes=strftime(_time, "%H:00")

table.title: Displays the average hourly Kerberos authentications received by each domain for a specified period of time (preferably the last 5-7 days). Additionally, this panel calculates the Hourly Threshold for each domain to be used for hunting anomalies.

search.query: | stats count by Day Hour Domain_Name | dedup Day Hour Domain_Name | stats avg(count) as AvgHourlyAuths by Domain_Name | eval HourlyThreshold=(AvgHourlyAuths*0.3) | table Domain_Name AvgHourlyAuths HourlyThreshold

table.title: Displays the usual login hours for each domain in a specified period of time (preferably the last 5-7 days).

search.query: | stats count by Day Hour_With_Minutes Domain_Name | lookup Base-HourlyThreshold.csv Domain_Name | eval IsUsualHour=if(count > HourlyThreshold, 1, 0) | dedup Hour_With_Minutes Domain_Name IsUsualHour | sort Domain_Name Day Hour_With_Minutes | stats values(Hour_With_Minutes) as UsualLoginHours by Domain_Name

panel.title: Lists the domain name and hour of authentication when a domain receives a number of Kerberos authentications above the threshold AND outside of the usual login hours calculated in above panels

search.query: | stats count by Day Hour_With_Minutes Domain_Name | lookup Base-UsualLoginHours.csv Domain_Name | eval HourlyThresholdForDomain=mvindex(HourlyThreshold, 0) | eval IsUsualHour=if(count > HourlyThresholdForDomain, 1, 0) | search IsUsualHour=0 | stats count by Domain_Name Hour_With_Minutes | eval IsOverThreshold=if(count > HourlyThresholdForDomain, 1, 0) | search IsOverThreshold=1 | table Domain_Name Hour_With_Minutes count

event.title: Displays Kerberos authentication events relating to previous panel

search.query: | stats count by Day Hour_With_Minutes Domain_Name | lookup Base-UsualLoginHours.csv Domain_Name | eval HourlyThresholdForDomain=mvindex(HourlyThreshold, 0) | eval IsUsualHour=if(count > HourlyThresholdForDomain, 1, 0) | search IsUsualHour=0 | stats count by Domain_Name Hour_With_Minutes | eval IsOverThreshold=if(count > HourlyThresholdForDomain, 1, 0) | search IsOverThreshold=1 | table Domain_Name Hour_With_Minutes count
